blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate nuclei segmentation underpins quantitative computational pathology, yet remains challenging due to morphological variability, weak boundaries, nuclear crowding, and pronounced domain shifts arising from differences in tissue preparation, staining, and acquisition. While deep learning and recent foundation models have improved segmentation performance under matched distributions with the original training data, their generalization across heterogeneous histopathology domains remains limited. We introduce GDBA-Net, a parameter-efficient nuclei segmentation framework built around the proposed Gated Dual-Branch Adapter (GDBA). GDBA-Net adapts a frozen SAM2 encoder by integrating pretrained semantic representations with explicit frequency-derived structural priors. The complementary representations are independently transformed through Grid MLP branches and dynamically integrated using sample-adaptive channel-wise gating, selectively emphasizing structural cues relevant to nuclear delineation. Despite using only 4.3 million trainable parameters, GDBA-Net achieves state-of-the-art in-dataset performance and consistently superior cross-dataset generalization across six diverse nuclei segmentation benchmarks under fully supervised, cross-dataset, and five-shot adaptation protocols, outperforming competing CNN-, transformer-, and foundation model based methods. Comprehensive ablations confirm that these gains arise from the coordinated design of semantic-frequency complementarity and adaptive gating rather than increased model capacity. By uniting transferable semantic representations with explicit structural priors, GDBA-Net provides a robust, annotation-efficient solution to domain variability in nuclei segmentation. https://github.com/biplabpoudel25/GDBA_Net
blocks.zh: 准确的核分裂是定量计算病理的基础,但由于形态变异、边界薄弱、核拥挤,以及组织准备、污渍和获取方面的差异导致的显著域转移,因此仍然具有挑战性。 虽然在与原始培训数据相匹配的分布下,深入学习和最近的基础模型提高了分化性能,但它们在不同的组织病理学领域的概括性仍然有限。 我们介绍了GDBA-Net,这是一个围绕拟议的Gated Dual-Branch适配器(GDBA)构建的参数高效的核分裂框架. GDBA-Net通过将预先训练的语义表达式与明确的频率衍生结构前缀整合,来调整一个冷冻的SAM2编码器. 互补的表示通过Grid MLP分支进行独立转化,并采用采样适应性通道导引法进行动态整合,有选择地强调与核划界相关的结构提示. GDBA-Net尽管只使用了430万个可训练参数,但还是实现了最先进的内数据集性能,并在完全监督的跨数据集和5发的适应协议下,在6个不同的核子分解基准上始终实现了优异的跨数据集通用化,其性能超过了竞争的CNN-、变压器和基于基础模型的方法。 全面分析证实,这些成果来自语义频率互补和适应性定位的协调设计,而不是增强模型能力。 GDBA-Net通过将可转移的语义表述与明确的结构前缀统一起来,为核分裂中的域变异性提供了有力,注解高效的解决方案. https://github.com/biplabpoudel25/GDBA_Net (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Accurate segmentation of cell nuclei from histopathological images constitutes a fundamental analytical step in computational pathology, serving as the gateway to downstream quantitative tasks, including cell counting, cell profiling, spatial transcriptomics mapping, and diagnostic decision support [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . The proliferation of digital pathology and whole-slide imaging (WSI) in modern clinical workflows has intensified the demand for automated, robust nuclei segmentation pipelines that alleviate the substantial annotation burden on pathologists and enable high-throughput, reproducible morphological analysis [ 4 ] . However, reliable nuclei delineation remains challenging because nuclei exhibit substantial variations in size, shape, appearance, and spatial organization, while weak boundaries, densely clustered cells, staining variability, and imaging artifacts further complicate segmentation [ 5 ] . More importantly, differences in tissue preparation, staining protocols, scanners, and acquisition conditions introduce pronounced domain shifts, causing models trained on one dataset to deteriorate when applied to unseen histopathological data.
blocks.zh: 将细胞核从组织病理学图像中精确分解,构成计算病理学中的一个基本分析步骤,成为下游定量任务的入门,包括细胞计数,细胞剖析,空间记录仪映射,以及诊断决策支持[1,2,3]. 数字病理学和全滑成像(WSI)在现代临床工作流程中的扩散,加大了对自动化,强固的核分化管的需求,缓解了病理学家的实质性注解负担并促成高通量,可再生形态分析[4]. 然而,可靠的核分界仍然具有挑战性,因为核子在大小、外形、外观和空间组织上表现出了巨大的差异,而边界薄弱、细胞密集、有污迹的可变性和成像文物进一步使分界复杂化[5]。 更重要的是,在组织准备、污渍协议、扫描仪和获取条件方面的差异引入了已宣告的域位转移,导致在一个数据集上受过训练的模型在应用到隐形组织病理学数据时恶化。

blocks.en: Traditional image processing methods, including watershed segmentation, adaptive thresholding, and handcrafted morphological descriptors, provided initial promise in controlled, homogeneous tissue settings [ 6 ] but were highly sensitive to staining variability, noise, and nuclear crowding, often requiring extensive parameter tuning and failing in complex tissue environments [ 7 ] . Deep learning substantially advanced the field, beginning with U-Net [ 8 ] and subsequently incorporating attention, multi-scale representations, instance-aware modeling, and transformer-based architectures [ 5 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] . Although these methods have achieved strong performance under matched training and testing distributions, robust generalization across heterogeneous datasets remains difficult. Their learned representations are largely driven by the source-domain appearance, making segmentation particularly vulnerable when staining characteristics, tissue morphology, or acquisition conditions differ from those encountered during training.
blocks.zh: 传统的图像处理方法,包括分水岭、适应性阈值和手工制作的形态描述符,在受控制、同质的组织环境中提供了初步承诺[6],但对污迹可变性、噪声和核拥挤非常敏感,往往需要在复杂的组织环境中进行广泛的参数调整并失效[7]。 深入学习大大地推进了这个领域,从U-Net[8]开始,并随后融入了关注,多尺度的表述,体会模型,以及基于变压器的建筑[5,9,10,11,12,13]. 虽然这些方法在匹配的培训和测试分布下取得了强效,但不同数据集之间的强力概括仍然很困难。 他们学习到的表述主要受源域外观所驱使,当污迹特征、组织形态或获取条件与培训时遇到的情况不同时,分化特别脆弱。

blocks.en: Vision foundation models provide a promising alternative by transferring representations learned from large and diverse image corpora. Segment Anything Model (SAM) [ 14 ] and its successor SAM2 [ 15 ] have demonstrated strong general-purpose segmentation capabilities, yet their direct transfer to fine-grained biomedical structures remains limited by the substantial gap between natural and histopathological images [ 16 , 17 ] . Medical fine-tuning approaches like MedSAM [ 18 ] , and MedSAM2 [ 19 ] , and parameter-efficient adaptation methods like SAMed [ 20 ] , SAM-Adapter [ 21 ] , SAM2-Adapter [ 22 ] , and the Medical SAM Adapter [ 23 ] , have improved their applicability while reducing the need to train task-specific models from scratch. Nevertheless, efficient adaptation alone does not fully address the representational requirements of nuclei segmentation.
blocks.zh: 愿景基础模型通过转移从大型和多样形象公司学到的表述,提供了一个有希望的替代方案。 任何部分模型(SAM)[14]及其后续的SAM2[15]都显示出强大的普通用途分化能力,然而,由于自然和病理学图像之间的巨大差距,它们直接转移到精细的生物医学结构上仍然受到限制[16,17]。 MeDSAM [18] 和 MeDSAM 2 [19] 等医疗微调方法,以及SAMed [20],SAM-Adapter [21],SAM2-Adapter [22] 和医疗SAM适配器[23]等参数高效的适应方法,提高了其适用性,同时从零开始减少了培训特定任务模型的需要. 然而,单靠有效的适应并不能充分满足核分裂的代表性要求。

blocks.en: High-level semantic features provide valuable contextual information, whereas accurate separation of densely packed nuclei also depends on fine structural cues associated with boundaries and local morphological transitions. Frequency-domain representations can emphasize such information [ 24 ] , but high-frequency components may simultaneously amplify staining irregularities, texture variations, and acquisition noise. Thus, a central challenge is not simply introducing structural information, but determining how structural and semantic representations should be selectively balanced during adaptation. Existing adapter methods have explored task-specific information, including high-frequency components [ 22 ] , but the adaptive integration of separately transformed structural and semantic representations remains insufficiently explored to achieve robust nuclei segmentation across heterogeneous domains.
blocks.zh: 高层次的语义特征提供了宝贵的背景信息,而精密包装的核糖体的精确分离也取决于与边界和局部形态过渡相关的细微结构提示. 频率域表示法可以强调这种信息[24],但高频组件可能同时扩大污渍的不规则,纹理变化和获取噪音. 因此,一个核心挑战不仅仅是引入结构信息,而是确定在适应过程中如何有选择地平衡结构和语义表述。 现有的适配器方法探索了针对具体任务的信息,包括高频组件[22],但单独变形的结构表达和语义表达的适应性整合仍然没有得到充分的探索,无法实现不同领域的强力核分裂.

blocks.en: In this work, we present GDBA-Net , a SAM2-based framework for robust multi-domain nuclei segmentation. The framework is motivated by the complementary strengths of pretrained deep representations for semantic abstraction and frequency-derived representations for capturing fine structural information. Its central component is the proposed Gated Dual-Branch Adapter (GDBA), which uses branch-specific Grid MLP adapters to independently process semantic and frequency-derived structural features before integrating them through sample-adaptive channel-wise gating. This design selectively emphasizes structural cues relevant to nuclear delineation while preserving the pretrained knowledge of the frozen encoder. We evaluate GDBA-Net across six morphologically diverse benchmarks - Kumar [ 25 ] , MoNuSeg [ 26 ] , CryoNuSeg [ 27 ] , CPM [ 28 ] , TNBC [ 29 ] , and CoNSeP [ 5 ] , under both in-dataset and rigorous cross-dataset generalization protocols.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们介绍了GDBA-Net,这是一个基于SAM2的强力多域核分裂框架. 该框架的动力是,语义抽象预加训练的深层表述和获取精细结构信息的频度表达具有互补性。 其中心部分是所拟议的Gated Dual-Branch适配器(GDBA),它使用分支特异性的Grid MLP适配器进行独立的过程语义和频率衍生的结构特征,再通过采样-适应性通道-导引来整合. 这种设计有选择地强调与核划界相关的结构提示,同时保留被预先训练的被冻结编码器知识. 我们评价GDBA-Net的六个不同形态的基准 -- -- Kumar [25]、MoNuSeg [26]、CryoNuSeg [27]、CPM [28]、TNBC [29] 和CoNSeP [5] -- -- 都采用数据集和严格的跨数据集通用化协议。

blocks.en:
The principal contributions of this paper are as follows: 1. We introduce GDBA-Net , a parameter-efficient dual-branch
adaptation framework for SAM2 that jointly leverages pretrained semantic
representations and frequency-derived structural information for robust
nuclei segmentation. 2. We develop a sample-adaptive channel-wise gating mechanism that dynamically balances semantic and structural information during adaptation. This design enables the model to selectively exploit fine structural cues while preserving transferable semantic knowledge, rather than relying on fixed or direct feature fusion. 3. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and strong cross-domain generalization across six heterogeneous nuclei segmentation benchmarks under in-dataset, cross-dataset, and few-shot settings outperforming eleven competing CNN-, transformer-, and foundation model-based methods. 4. We establish the effectiveness and efficiency of GDBA-Net through few-shot adaptation and systematic ablation studies. Additional experiments on retinal vessel and skin lesion segmentation further support the applicability of the proposed adaptation strategy beyond nuclei segmentation.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Deep Learning for Nuclei Segmentation
blocks.zh: II-A 深入学习核心部分

blocks.en: Deep convolutional neural networks, anchored by the U-Net architecture [ 8 ] , have become the dominant paradigm for biomedical image segmentation. In the nuclei segmentation literature, architectural innovations such as attention mechanisms [ 30 ] , dense skip connections [ 31 ] , and multi-scale feature pyramids [ 32 ] progressively improved performance on standard benchmarks. Task-specific frameworks addressing the challenge of overlapping nuclei further advanced the field: StarDist [ 11 ] predicts object probabilities together with radial distances that define star-convex polygonal representation, while HoVer-Net [ 5 ] decomposes the segmentation task into horizontal and vertical gradient prediction branches to enable instance separation in crowded tissues. DAN-NucNet [ 33 ] incorporates spatial and channel attention to enhance nuclear representations under heterogeneous histological conditions. Transformer-based architectures, including [ 12 ] , Swin-UNet [ 13 ] , HiFormer [ 34 ] , and TransNuSeg [ 35 ] , subsequently improved the modeling of long-range dependencies and global-local context. Although these methods substantially improve representation learning and instance separation, these architectural advances do not inherently ensure robustness to domain shifts across tissue types, staining characteristics, preparation protocols, and acquisition conditions.
blocks.zh: 以U-Net架构为主的深层革命神经网络[8]已经成为生物医学影像分化的主导范式. 在核分化文献中,关注机制等建筑创新[30],密集跳过连接[31],多尺度地物金字塔[32]在标准基准上逐渐提高性能. 应对核相重叠挑战的具体任务框架进一步推进了领域:StarDist[11] 预测物体概率,同时预测确定恒星-视线多边形表示的射线距离;而HoVer-Net[5] 将分层任务分解为横向和纵向梯度预测分支,以便在拥挤的组织中实现实例分离. DAN-NucNet[33]纳入空间和引导注意力,以便在不同的组织条件下加强核代表。 基于变形器的建筑,包括[12],Swin-UNet [13],HiFormer [34],和TransNuSeg [35],后来改进了长距离依赖和全局背景的模型化. 虽然这些方法大大地改进了代表性学习和实例分离,但这些建筑进步本身并不能确保域域在组织类型、污渍特征、准备协议和获取条件之间的强性。

blocks.en: II-B Domain Shift and Generalization in Computational Pathology
blocks.zh: II-B 计算病理学领域的域转移和概括

blocks.en: Domain shift remains a major challenge in computational pathology, where variations in staining, tissue preparation, scanners, and acquisition protocols can substantially alter image appearance and degrade performance on unseen data [ 36 , 37 ] . Cross-domain evaluations have further demonstrated that strong performance within a single dataset does not necessarily translate across acquisition conditions or institutions [ 38 ] . Consequently, domain-generalization methods have explored appearance perturbation, representation learning, and frequency-based augmentation to reduce dependence on source-specific characteristics [ 39 , 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 域位变化仍然是计算病理学的一大挑战,在这种病理学中,污渍、组织准备、扫描仪和获取协议的变异可大大地改变图像外观并降低在无形数据上的性能[36、37]。 跨领域评价进一步表明,在一个单一数据集内的强效业绩不一定在采购条件或机构之间转化[38]。 因此,域通化方法探索了外观扰动、表现学习和以频率为基础的增强,以减少对源特性的依赖[39、40]。

blocks.en: II-C Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Foundational Models
blocks.zh: II-C 参数 -- -- 有效优化基本模型

blocks.en: The emergence of segmentation foundation models has created new opportunities for transferring large-scale visual representations to medical imaging. SAM [ 14 ] introduced promptable general-purpose segmentation, while SAM2 [ 15 ] extended this paradigm using a hierarchical multi-scale encoder. However, large-scale pretraining on natural images does not eliminate the domain gap to specialized medical imagery, while full-model fine-tuning can impose substantial computational and memory requirements, particularly when task-specific annotations are limited. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) strategies, originally developed for natural language processing and later extended to vision models, have emerged as a principled solution. In medical imaging, approaches such as SAMed [ 20 ] applied low-rank adaptation (LoRA) to the SAM image encoder, while SAM-Adapter [ 21 ] , SAM2-Adapter [ 22 ] , and the Medical SAM Adapter [ 23 ] introduce lightweight mechanisms for incorporating task- or domain-specific information while retaining much of the pretrained representation. MedSAM [ 18 ] and MedSAM2 [ 19 ] instead rely on full or partial fine-tuning on curated medical datasets.
blocks.zh: 分化基础模型的出现为将大规模视觉表现转移到医学成像上创造了新的机会. SAM [14]引入了可快速通用分解,而SAM 2 [15]则使用分级多尺度编码器来扩展了这一范式. 然而,对自然影像进行大规模预训并不能消除专业医学影像的域间隙,而全模型的微调可以施加大量的计算和内存要求,特别是在任务特定说明有限的情况下. 参数效率微调(PEFT)战略最初是为自然语言处理而制定,后被推广到视觉模型,现已成为一种原则性的解决办法. 在医学成像中,SAMed [20]等方法对SAM图像编码器应用了低等适应(LORA),而SAM-Adapter [21],SAM2-Adapter [22],和医学SAM适配器 [23] 则引入了轻量级机制,将任务或领域特定信息纳入其中,同时保留了被预先训练的大部分代表. MeDSAM [18] 和 MeDSAM 2 [19] 转而依靠对所编译的医疗数据集的全部或部分微调.

blocks.en: These approaches demonstrate that foundational models can be effectively specialized without developing task-specific architectures from scratch. However, they differ substantially in the number of trainable parameters, the form of task-specific information introduced, and the extent to which the pretrained backbone is modified. Moreover, most were developed for broad downstream or medical segmentation tasks rather than specifically addressing fine-grained nuclear structure and cross-dataset robustness in heterogeneous histopathology.
blocks.zh: 这些方法表明,基本模式可以有效专业化,而不从零开始发展具体任务的架构。 然而,它们在可训练参数的数目、采用的具体任务信息的形式以及预先训练的主干线被修改的程度方面差别很大。 此外,大多数是用于广泛的下游或医疗分解任务,而不是专门处理各种组织病理学的细微核结构和跨数据集强健性。

blocks.en: II-D Frequency-Domain Feature Integration
blocks.zh: II-D 频域集成

blocks.en: Frequency-domain representations have been increasingly investigated to improve robustness to distribution shift. Fourier Domain Adaptation and related approaches have demonstrated that manipulating frequency components can improve domain adaptation and generalization, including in medical image segmentation. Frequency-aware architectures such as FRUNet [ 41 ] have further shown the value of high-frequency information for capturing fine-grained structural details in biomedical segmentation. However, these approaches primarily employ frequency information for distribution manipulation, augmentation, or feature attention.
blocks.zh: 对频率域表示进行了越来越多的调查,以提高分配变化的稳健性。 Fourier域适应和相关方法表明,操纵频率组件可以改善域适应和通化,包括在医疗图像分解方面。 FRUNet等频率感知架构[41]进一步展示了高频信息在生物医学分化中捕捉精细纹理结构细节的价值. 然而,这些办法主要利用频率信息来操纵、增加或引起注意。

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: III-A Proposed Architecture Overview

blocks.en: The proposed GDBA-Net framework, as shown in Figure 1 , adapts the hierarchical image encoder of SAM2 for nuclei segmentation using the Gated Dual-Branch Adapter (GDBA). blocks.en: To adapt these pretrained representations for nuclei segmentation, GDBA integrates semantic information from the SAM2 encoder with frequency-derived structural information from the input image. The resulting adaptation features are injected into the corresponding SAM2 tokens through residual addition before the associated transformer blocks, enabling task-specific adaptation throughout the hierarchical encoder.
blocks.zh: 为了适应这些被预先训练的表示来进行核分解,GDBA将来自SAM2编码器的语义信息与从输入图像中产生的频率结构信息相融合. 由此产生的适应性能通过相关变压器块前的剩余添加被注入到相应的SAM2令牌中,从而在整个分级编码器中实现特定任务的适应.

blocks.en: IV EXPERIMENTAL SETUP
blocks.zh: 四. 警告性言论

blocks.en: IV-A Datasets
blocks.zh: 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed framework on six publicly available H&E-stained nuclei segmentation benchmarks: Kumar [ 25 ] , MoNuSeg [ 26 ] , CryoNuSeg [ 27 ] , Combined CPM [ 28 ] , TNBC [ 29 ] , and CoNSeP [ 5 ] . These datasets encompass diverse tissue types, image resolutions, and preparation protocols, providing a comprehensive setting for evaluating both in-dataset performance and cross-dataset generalization. Table I summarizes the characteristics of each dataset along with the training, validation, and testing partitions used in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们评价拟议框架的六个可公开获得的H&E具有核分化基准:Kumar [25]、MoNuSeg [26]、CryoNuSeg [27]、CPM [28]、TNBC [29]和CoNSeP [5]。 这些数据集包含不同的组织类型,图像分辨率,以及准备协议,为评价数据集内性能和跨数据集通论提供了全面的设置. 页:1 我总结了每个数据集的特点 以及我们实验中使用的培训、验证和测试分区。

blocks.en: The validation sets were separated from the available training data and used for model selection, while the test sets were reserved exclusively for final evaluation. For the Combined CPM dataset, CPM-15 and CPM-17 were merged by combining their respective training, validation, and test partitions. The same fixed partitions were used across all competing methods to ensure consistent comparison.
blocks.zh: 鉴定组从现有的培训数据中分离出来,用于模型选择,而测试组则专门用于最后评价。 对于CPM综合数据集,CPM-15和CPM-17通过结合各自的培训,验证和测试分区合并. 所有相互竞争的方法都使用同样的固定分区,以确保一致的比较。

blocks.en: IV-B Experimental Protocols
blocks.zh: 四-B 实验议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate GDBA-Net under two complementary settings: in-dataset evaluation and cross-dataset generalization. In the in-dataset setting, models are trained and evaluated using the training and testing partitions of the same dataset. In the cross-dataset setting, models trained on a source dataset are directly evaluated on the unseen target dataset without target-domain fine-tuning, providing a measure of robustness under domain shift. To further examine the effect of limited target-domain supervision, we compare direct cross-dataset transfer with 5-shot target-domain adaptation and full target-domain training. In the 5-shot setting, five target-domain images are used for training, a small subset is retained for validation, and the remaining images are used for testing. Additionally, the applicability of GDBA-Net beyond nuclei segmentation is evaluated on distinct biomedical segmentation tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们评价GDBA-Net在两个互补环境中:数据集内评价和跨数据集通论. 在数据集设置中,使用同一数据集的培训和测试分区,对模型进行培训和评价. 在跨数据集设置中,在未对目标域进行微调的情况下,在未见目标数据集上直接评价受源数据集培训的模型,提供域移下稳健度的度量. 为了进一步审查有限目标领域监督的影响,我们将直接跨数据集传输与5发目标领域调整和全面目标领域培训进行比较。 在5发设定中,有5个目标域图像用于训练,保留一个小子集用于验证,其余图像用于测试. 此外,还评估了GDBA-Net在核分裂以外的适用性,即不同的生物医学分裂任务。

blocks.en: V RESULTS
blocks.zh: 五 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate GDBA-Net across heterogeneous nuclei segmentation benchmarks to examine its segmentation accuracy, robustness to domain shift, and ability to adapt under limited target-domain supervision. Comparisons with conventional CNN-, transformer-, nuclei-specific, and foundation model-based approaches are used to assess performance across varying tissue types, preparation protocols, and imaging characteristics.
blocks.zh: 我们评价GDBA-Net不同核分化基准,以审查其分化的准确性、对域位变化的稳健性以及在有限的目标域监督下适应的能力。 与传统的有线电视新闻网(CNN),变压器(变压器),核特异性和基于基础模型的方法进行比较,用于评估不同组织类型、准备协议和成像特征的性能。

blocks.en: V-A In-dataset evaluation
blocks.zh: V-A 数据集内评价

blocks.en: Table II presents the in-dataset performance on MoNuSeg, Kumar, and CryoNuSeg, where models are trained and tested on the same dataset. GDBA-Net achieves the highest Dice and Jaccard scores on all three datasets, demonstrating consistently accurate segmentation across diverse tissue types, image characteristics, and preparation protocols. The comparison further shows that architectural complexity or foundation-model pretraining alone does not guarantee strong segmentation performance. While nnU-Net, HoVer-Net, and DanNucNet provide competitive results, transformer-based models and directly adapted SAM variants show less consistent performance across datasets. In contrast, GDBA-Net maintains strong performance under both FFPE and cryo-sectioned imaging conditions, supporting the effectiveness of combining SAM2 semantic representations with frequency-derived structural information. Notably, the 5-shot GDBA-Net achieves a 0.8359 Dice on CryoNuSeg, surpassing fully trained foundational models like MedSAM. Overall, these results establish the proposed method as a robust and annotation-efficient approach for in-dataset nuclei segmentation.
blocks.zh: 表二列出了MoNuSeg、Kumar和CryoNuSeg上的数据集内性能,在同一数据集对模型进行了培训和测试。 GDBA-Net在所有三个数据集上都取得了最高的Dice和Jaccard分数,在不同的组织类型、图像特征和准备协议中都显示出一致的准确分化。 比较进一步表明,仅靠建筑复杂性或地基-模型预训并不能保证强大的分化性能. 虽然nnU-Net,HoVer-Net,和DanNucNet提供竞争结果,但基于变压器的模型和直接被改造的SAM变体显示各数据集的性能不太一致. 相形之下,GDBA-Net在FFPE和低温分解成像条件下保持了强效,支持将SAM2语义表达与频率生成的结构信息相结合的有效性. 值得注意的是,5发的GDBA-Net在CryoNuSeg上达到了0.8359分,超过了MedSAM等训练有素的基础模型. 总的来说,这些结果将拟议方法确定为对数据集内核分化的有力和说明效率高的方法。

blocks.en: V-B Cross-dataset generalization
blocks.zh: V-B 跨数据集通论

blocks.en: Table III presents cross-dataset generalization by training on a single source dataset and directly testing it on unseen target datasets without target-domain fine-tuning. Across the eight source-target combinations, GDBA-Net achieves the highest Dice and Jaccard scores in seven settings and ranks second in the remaining CoNSeP-to-CPM evaluation. This consistent performance across multiple source-target combinations indicates robustness to variations in tissue composition, staining appearance, image resolution, and preparation protocol.
blocks.zh: 表三通过对单一源数据集的培训,并直接在未发现的目标数据集上进行测试而无需对目标域进行微调,介绍跨数据集的概括化. 通过8个源-目标组合,GDBA-Net在7个设置中实现了最高的Dice和Jaccard分数,并在CONSEP对CPM的剩余评价中排名第二. 这种跨越多个源-目标组合的一致性能表明组织组成、污迹外观、图像分辨率和制备协议的强性。

blocks.en: When trained on MoNuSeg, GDBA-Net achieves the best overlap performance on all three unseen datasets, with particularly clear improvements on TNBC (Dice: 0.8146), where methods such as nnU-Net and U-Net obtained substantially lower performance. Although DanNucNet remains competitive on CPM, its Dice decreases to 0.5338 on TNBC, demonstrating that strong transfer to one target dataset does not necessarily ensure consistent cross-domain generalization. A similar pattern is observed when CryoNuSeg is used as the source domain, with GDBA-Net achieving the highest Dice and Jaccard scores across the evaluated target datasets. Several competing models retain high Precision or Specificity under this shift but exhibit considerably lower overlap scores, suggesting conservative predictions that fail to recover substantial portions of the nuclear regions. In contrast, GDBA-Net maintains a better balance between nuclear detection and background discrimination.
blocks.zh: 在接受关于MoNuSeg的培训后,GDBA-Net在所有三个不见踪影的数据集上都实现了最佳的重叠性能,对TNBC(Dice:0.8146)有特别明显的改进,其中nU-Net和U-Net等方法获得的性能大大降低. 虽然DanNucNet在CPM上仍然具有竞争力,但其Dice在TNBC上却下降到了0.5338,表明向一个目标数据集的有力传输并不一定能确保一致的跨域通论. CryoNuSeg被用作源域时也观察到了类似的模式,GDBA-Net在被评价的目标数据集中实现了最高的Dice和Jaccard分数. 一些相互竞争的模型在这一转变下保留了高精度或特异性,但重叠的分数要低得多,这表明保守的预测无法恢复大部分核区域。 相比之下,GDBA-Net在核探测和背景歧视之间保持了更好的平衡。

blocks.en: A more challenging pattern emerges when CoNSeP is used as the source domain. Although HoVer-Net achieves the highest overlap on CPM, GDBA-Net produces the highest precision and specificity, indicating fewer false-positive predictions. More importantly, GDBA-Net regains the leading overlap performance on the CoNSeP to TNBC transfer, whereas HoVer-Net shows a substantial decrease despite its strong performance on CPM. This contrast highlights that success on a single dataset doesn’t necessarily indicate robust cross-domain generalization.
blocks.zh: 当CoNSeP被用作源域时,出现了更具挑战性的模式. 虽然HoVer-Net在CPM上实现了最高的重叠,但GDBA-Net能产生最高的精度和特异性,表明假阳性预测较少. 更重要的是,GDBA-Net恢复了CoNSeP到TNBC传输的领先重叠性能,而HoVer-Net尽管在CPM上的表现很强,却显示出大幅下降. 这一对比凸显出,在单一数据集上的成功并不一定表明有力的跨域通论。

blocks.en: The per-image distributions in Figure 4 provide further insight into this behavior. Under in-dataset evaluation on CryoNuSeg, most methods exhibit relatively compact performance distributions. When transferred from CryoNuSeg to CPM, the distributions become substantially wider for several competing methods, indicating increased sensitivity to individual target images under domain shift. GDBA-Net maintains a comparatively high central tendency for Dice and Jaccard while avoiding the pronounced degradation observed for several baselines. The Precision and Specificity distributions further show that high background classification performance can coexist with substantially reduced segmentation overlap under cross-domain transfer. Overall, these results suggest that integrating pretrained semantic representations with frequency-derived structural information improves resistance to domain-specific appearance variations and enables more reliable segmentation of previously unseen histopathology data.
blocks.zh: 图4中的平面图像分布为这种行为提供了更深入的见解. 在CryoNuSeg的数据集评价下,大多数方法表现出相对紧凑的性能分布. 在从 CryoNuSeg 转到CPM 时,分布因几种相竞方法而变得相去甚远,表明在域相移时对单个目标图像的敏感度提高. GDBA-Net保持了Dice和Jaccard相对较高的中心趋势,同时避免了观察到的几个基线的明显退化。 精度和特异性分布进一步表明,高背景分类性能可以在跨域转移下与大量减少分化重叠并存. 总体而言,这些结果表明,将事先经过训练的语义表述与频率生成的结构信息相结合,提高了对域特有外观变化的抵抗力并使得先前未见的组织病理学数据能够更可靠地分解.

blocks.en: V-C Generalization vs target-domain adaptation
blocks.zh: V-C 概论与目标领域适应

blocks.en: Figure 5 compares the performance of GDBA-Net under direct cross-dataset transfer, 5-shot target-domain adaptation, and full target-domain training on CPM, TNBC, and CoNSeP. On CPM and TNBC, cross-dataset transfer remains close to few-shot and fully supervised performance, indicating that GDBA-Net transfers effectively when the source and target domains have comparable nuclear characteristics. In contrast, a larger performance gap is observed on CoNSeP, where direct transfer from MoNuSeg or CryoNuSeg results in lower performance. Introducing only five labeled target-domain images substantially narrows this gap towards the fully supervised performance. These results demonstrate that GDBA-Net can maintain strong generalization when domain shift is moderate, while limited target-domain supervision provides substantial benefits under more challenging domain shifts.
blocks.zh: 图5比较了GDBA-Net在直接跨数据集传输,5发目标域适应,以及CPM,TNBC,和CoNSeP等全目标域培训下的性能. 在CPM和TNBC上,跨数据集传输仍然接近于几发并充分监督的性能,表明GDBA-Net在源与目标域具有可比较的核特性时有效传输. 相比之下,在CoNSeP上观察到的性能差距较大,从MoNuSeg或CryoNuSeg直接转移导致性能较低. 只采用5个标有标记的目标领域图像,大大缩小了这一差距,使其与完全监督的性能相去甚远。 这些结果表明,GDBA-Net在域位转移适度时可以保持强通化,而有限的目标域监督在更具挑战性的域位转移下则能提供巨大的好处.

blocks.en: V-D Qualitative segmentation analysis
blocks.zh: V-D 定性分解分析

blocks.en: Figure 6 presents a qualitative comparison of segmentation results on representative samples. U-Net, Attention U-Net, PSPNet, and SAM exhibit false-positive regions, over-segmentation, or missed nuclei, particularly in densely populated regions. Although HoVer-Net and MedSAM yield stronger masks, some nuclei remain incomplete or missed. In comparison, GDBA-Net more closely follows the ground-truth masks, with improved boundary delineation and fewer false-positive and false-negative regions.
blocks.zh: 图6对代表性样品的分解结果进行了定性比较。 U-Net、Content U-Net、PSPNet和SAM呈现出虚假阳性区域、过于分化或缺失核,特别是在人口稠密地区。 虽然HoVer-Net和MedSAM产生更强的口罩,但有些核糖体仍然不完整或缺失. 相比之下,GDBA-Net更密切地跟踪地面真相口罩,边界划定得到改善,假阳性和假阴性区域减少。

Ground-truth masks and overlap maps produced by the competing methods are shown for visual comparison. In the overlay, white denotes correctly segmented nuclei pixels, red denotes false positives predictions, and blue indicates false negatives predictions.

blocks.en: V-E Parameter Efficiency
blocks.zh: V-E 参数效率

blocks.en: Despite leveraging the powerful SAM2 backbone, GDBA-Net restricts optimization to the lightweight GDBA modules while keeping the pretrained encoder frozen. As shown in Figure 7 , the proposed framework requires only 4.3 million trainable parameters, fewer than several competing models while maintaining strong segmentation performance. This favorable balance between trainable model capacity and segmentation accuracy highlights the parameter-efficient nature of the proposed adaptation strategy.
blocks.zh: 尽管利用了强大的SAM2主干线,GDBA-Net限制对轻量级的GDBA模块进行优化,同时将预训编码器冻结. 如图7所示,拟议框架只需要430万个可训练参数,少于几个相互竞争的模型,同时保持强大的分块性能。 这种在可培训模型能力和分化准确性之间有利的平衡突出了拟议适应战略的参数效率。

blocks.zh: 发相. 7:GDBA和相竞分化方法的可训练参数数比较.

blocks.en: V-F Applicability to Additional Biomedical Segmentation Tasks
blocks.zh: V-F 适用于额外的生物医学分裂任务

blocks.en: To examine the applicability of GDBA-Net beyond nuclei segmentation, we further evaluate the framework on two distinct biomedical segmentation tasks: retinal vessel segmentation using DRIVE [ 43 ] and skin lesion segmentation using ISIC 2018 dataset [ 44 , 45 ] . DRIVE contains retinal fundus images with pixel-level vessel annotations, whereas ISIC 2018 contains dermoscopic images with corresponding skin lesion masks. These datasets provide additional evaluation of GDBA-Net across structures and imaging characteristics that differ substantially from histopathological nuclei.
blocks.zh: 为了审查GDBA-Net在核分裂之外的适用性,我们进一步评价两个不同的生物医学分化任务的框架:使用DRIE[43]的视网膜容器分化和使用ISIC 2018数据集的皮肤损伤分化[44,45]。 DRIVE包含有像素级容器说明的视网膜基金图象,而2018年国际标准行业分类包含有相应皮肤损伤口罩的皮肤镜象. 这些数据集提供了对GDBA-Net跨结构和成像特征的额外评价,这些结构和成像特征与组织病理核有很大不同.

blocks.en: As shown in Table IV , GDBA-Net has better performance across both datasets and evaluation metrics. The strong performance across two structurally distinct segmentation tasks indicates that the benefits of integrating pretrained semantic representations with frequency-derived structural information are not limited to nuclei segmentation. This further supports GDBA-Net’s adaptability across diverse biomedical segmentation tasks.
blocks.zh: 如表四所示,全球数据库、数据和分析网在数据集和评价衡量尺度方面都有更好的表现。 两项结构上截然不同的分化任务的强劲表现表明,将预先经过训练的语义表述与频率衍生的结构信息相融合的好处并不限于核分化. 这进一步支持了GDBA-Net在各种生物医学分类任务的适应性.

blocks.en: VI ABLATION STUDIES
blocks.zh: 六 案例研究

blocks.en: VI-A Contribution of GDBA components
blocks.zh: GDBA部分的贡献

blocks.en: To systematically assess the contribution of the GDBA components, we evaluate multiple architectural configurations on the MoNuSeg and CryoNuSeg datasets (Table V ). Removing either the frequency or semantic branch reduces segmentation performance, demonstrating the complementary contribution of structural and semantic representations. Disabling the gating mechanism also degrades segmentation quality, confirming that adaptive weighting of the two feature streams is more effective than direct fusion. Replacing the shared projection with independent stage-specific projections increases the number of trainable parameters while reducing overlap performance. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of GDBA-Net stems from the coordinated contributions of its dual-branch representation, adaptive gating, and parameter-efficient shared-projection design.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地评估GDBA组件的贡献,我们评价了MoNuSeg和CryoNuSeg数据集(表五)上的多个建筑配置. 切除频率或语义分支会降低分化性能,表明结构和语义表达的互补作用. 断裂取出分解机制也会降解分解质量,证实两个特征流的适应性分解比直接聚变更有效. 以独立的阶段性预测取代共享预测可增加可训练参数的数量,同时减少重叠性能. 这些调查结果表明,GDBA-Net的有效性源于其双重分支代表、适应性地定位和参数效率高的共享预测设计的协调贡献。

Increasing capacity ( α = 8 \alpha=8 ) increases the parameter count to 10.23M without improving segmentation, while stronger compression ( α = 64 \alpha=64 ) slightly reduces both parameters and overlap performance.

blocks.en: VII DISCUSSION
blocks.zh: 七. 讨论

blocks.en: The proposed framework improves nuclei segmentation by combining a frozen foundation model encoder with a lightweight domain adaptation mechanism that integrates pretrained semantic representations with frequency-derived structural information. While the gains under matched training and testing distributions were relatively modest, the advantage became considerably more evident under domain shift, where GDBA-Net achieved the highest Dice and Jaccard scores in seven of the eight evaluated source-target settings. This is particularly important in computational pathology, where variations in tissue type, preparation, staining, and acquisition can substantially alter image appearance and limit the generalizability of models optimized for a single dataset.
blocks.zh: 拟议框架通过将冷冻地基模型编码器与轻量级域适应机制相结合,将预先训练的语义表达与频率生成的结构信息相融合,改善了核分裂. 虽然在匹配的培训和测试分布下的收益相对不大,但在域名转换下这一优势明显地更加明显,GDBA-Net在8个受评价的源-目标设置中,有7个获得最高的Dice和Jaccard分数。 这一点在计算病理学中尤其重要,组织类型,制备,污渍和获取的变异会大大地改变图像外观并限制为单一数据集所优化的模型的通俗性.

blocks.en: The cross-dataset results suggest that the complementary design of GDBA-Net is central to this robustness. SAM2 provides rich pretrained semantic representations, whereas the frequency branch emphasizes structural information associated with nuclear boundaries and local intensity transitions. Their integration allows the model to rely on information that is potentially less sensitive to source-specific appearance. This is especially evident in the strong transfer from CryoNuSeg to FFPE datasets despite their distinct preparation characteristics. Importantly, the CoNSeP-to-CPM setting, where HoVer-Net achieved higher overlap, also demonstrates that no representation is universally optimal and highlights the importance of evaluating generalization across multiple source-target combinations rather than isolated datasets.
blocks.zh: 交叉数据集的结果表明,全球数据库、数据库和网络的补充设计是这种稳健性的核心。 SAM2提供了丰富的先行语义表达,而频率分支则强调与核边界和局部强度过渡相关的结构信息. 它们的整合使模型能够依赖对特定源外观可能不太敏感的信息. 这在CryoNuSeg向FFPE数据集的强力传输中尤其明显,尽管数据集的准备特性不同. 重要的是,在CoNSeP-to-CPM设定中,HoVer-Net实现了更高的重叠,这也表明,没有一种代表性是普遍最佳的,并强调了评价跨多个源-目标组合而不是孤立数据集的通用的重要性。

blocks.en: The adaptation experiments further reveal a practical relationship between domain shift and annotation requirements. For CPM and TNBC, direct cross-dataset transfer of GDBA-Net remained close to target-domain-supervised performance, suggesting that limited or no additional target-domain annotation may be sufficient when cross-domain is already strong. For CoNSeP, where direct cross-domain transfer exhibited a larger performance gap, only five labeled target images recovered a substantial portion of the gap towards fully supervised performance. GDBA-Net therefore provides a practical continuum between direct cross-domain transfer, limited target-domain adaptation, and full target-domain training, which is valuable in histopathology where pixel-level annotation by experts is expensive and time-consuming.
blocks.zh: 适应实验进一步揭示出域位移与注释要求之间的实际关系. 对于CPM和TNBC来说,GDBA-Net的直接跨数据集传输仍然接近目标域监督的性能,这表明在跨域已经强大的情况下,有限的或没有额外的目标域注释可能就足够了. 对于CoNSeP来说,直接的跨域传输显示出更大的性能差距,只有5个标有标签的目标图像在完全监督的性能方面恢复了很大一部分差距。 因此,GDBA-Net在直接跨域转移、有限的目标域调整和完全的目标域培训之间提供了一个实际的连续体,这对专家在像素级注释中花费大量时间的病理学很有价值。

blocks.en: The ablation studies reinforce that these gains originate from architectural design rather than increased trainable model capacity. Removing either feature branch or the gating mechanism consistently degraded overlap performance, confirming the benefit of complementary representations and their adaptive integration. Moreover, increasing the number of trainable parameters through independent projections or a wider bottleneck did not improve segmentation. With only approximately 4.3M trainable parameters, GDBA-Net demonstrates that foundation models can be effectively specialized for nuclei segmentation without full backbone fine-tuning. This combination of cross-domain robustness, adaptation with limited target-domain supervision, and parameter efficiency highlights the potential of the proposed design to specialize large pretrained models for fine-grained biomedical segmentation tasks.
blocks.zh: 消化研究强调,这些成果来自建筑设计,而不是增加可培训模型的能力。 取消特征分支或取景机制的重叠性能持续退化,确认互补代表及其适应性融合的好处。 此外,通过独立预测或更广泛的瓶颈增加可训练参数的数量并没有改善分区。 GDBA-Net仅能提供大约4.3M可训练参数,这表明基础模型可以有效地专门用于核分裂,而无需完全的主干线微调. 这种跨域稳健性,有有限目标域监督的适应性,以及参数效率的结合,凸显出拟议设计将大型预训模型专门用于精细分化任务的潜力.

blocks.en: Despite these findings, the present study is limited to H&E nuclei segmentation using publicly available datasets. Although the additional experiments on retinal vessel and skin lesion segmentation provide initial evidence of applicability beyond histopathological nuclei, broader validation across imaging modalities, institutions, acquisition systems, and segmentation tasks are still needed to establish the generality of the approach. In addition, the current frequency extraction uses a fixed filtering strategy, and the effect of the frequency cutoff has not been systematically investigated. Learning or adapting the relevant frequency components may further improve performance across varying resolutions and noise characteristics. Future work will therefore explore adaptive frequency modeling, instance-level nuclear segmentation, and extension of the GDBA principle to other computational pathology and medical imaging tasks.
blocks.zh: 尽管得出了这些结论,本研究仅限于使用公开的数据集进行H&E核分解. 虽然关于视网膜容器和皮肤损伤分解的补充实验提供了超出组织病理核的可适用性的初步证据,但为了确定该方法的通用性,仍需要更广泛的不同成像模式、机构、获取系统和分解任务的验证。 此外,当前频率提取采用固定的滤波策略,而频率截取的效果尚未得到系统的调查. 学习或调整相关频率组件可进一步提高不同分辨率和噪音特性的性能。 因此,今后的工作将探索适应频率模型、实例级核分解,并将全球核分解法原则扩大到其他计算病理和医学成像任务。

blocks.en: VIII CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: 八. 结论

blocks.en: This study introduced GDBA-Net, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework built around the Gated Dual-Branch Adapter (GDBA), which integrates frequency-domain structural priors with pretrained semantic representations for robust nuclei segmentation. Through adaptive channel-wise gating and shared stage-specific projections, GDBA effectively incorporates complementary structural and semantic information into the hierarchical encoder. Evaluations across six heterogeneous histopathology datasets demonstrated accurate in-dataset segmentation, robust generalization to unseen domains, and effective adaptation using only five labeled target images. Additional evaluations on retinal vessel and skin lesion segmentation further demonstrated the applicability of the proposed adaptation strategy beyond nuclei segmentation. The ablation results further confirmed that these improvements arise from the coordinated design of the semantic and frequency branches, the gating mechanism, and the shared projection rather than increased trainable model capacity.
blocks.zh: 这项研究引入了GDBA-Net,这是一个围绕Gated Dual-Branch适配器(GDBA)构建的参数高效的适应框架,它将频率域结构前缀与预先训练过的语义表现相融合,用于强核分化. GDBA通过适应性通道的指向和共享的相位预测,有效地将互补的结构和语义信息纳入分级编码器. 对6个不同的组织病理学数据集进行的评估显示,数据组合中存在准确的分解,对隐形域进行了有力的概括,并且只使用5个标有标签的目标图像进行了有效的调整。 关于视网膜容器和皮肤损伤分化的其他评价进一步表明,拟议的适应战略在核分裂之外还适用。 减速结果还进一步证实,这些改进源于语义和频率分支的协调设计,取景机制,以及共享投影而非增强可训练模型能力.

blocks.en: More broadly, these findings demonstrate the value of combining task-relevant structural priors with transferable semantic representations. The strong cross-dataset performance of GDBA-Net suggests that their adaptive integration can improve robustness to domain-specific appearance variations while preserving fine structural information. GDBA-Net therefore provides a parameter- and annotation-efficient strategy for addressing two persistent challenges in computational pathology: domain variability and limited labeled data. Beyond nuclei segmentation, the results suggest that the proposed adaptation principle may provide a useful direction for specializing foundation models to fine-grained biomedical segmentation tasks where structural information and cross-domain robustness are important.
blocks.zh: 更广泛地说,这些调查结果表明,将与任务相关的结构前科与可转移语义表述结合起来的价值。 GDBA-Net的强跨数据集性能表明,它们的适应性融合可以改善对特定域外观变异的稳健性,同时保留精细的结构信息. 因此,GDBA-Net提供了一个参数和注释效率高的战略,以解决计算病理方面的两个持续挑战:域可变性和有限标签数据。 除了核分裂外,结果表明,拟议的适应原则可以为专门的基础模型提供有益的方向,用于在结构信息和跨领域稳健性十分重要的情况下完成精细分化生物医学任务。
